136struct FActorLastRenderTime
137{
138 UE_DEPRECATED(5.6, "Use GetLastRenderTime/SetLastRenderTime instead.")
139 std::atomic<float> LastRenderTime;
140
141 void SetLastRenderTime(float InLastRenderTime)
142 {
143 PRAGMA_DISABLE_DEPRECATION_WARNINGS
144 LastRenderTime.store(InLastRenderTime, std::memory_order_relaxed);
145 PRAGMA_ENABLE_DEPRECATION_WARNINGS
146 }
147
148 float GetLastRenderTime() const
149 {
150 PRAGMA_DISABLE_DEPRECATION_WARNINGS
151 return LastRenderTime.load(std::memory_order_relaxed);
152 PRAGMA_ENABLE_DEPRECATION_WARNINGS
153 }
154
155 UE_DEPRECATED(5.8, "Use HasAlwaysVisibleComponents/IncrementAlwaysVisibleComponents/DecrementAlwaysVisibleComponents instead.")
156 std::atomic_int32_t NumAlwaysVisibleComponents = 0;
157
158 bool HasAlwaysVisibleComponents() const
159 {
160 PRAGMA_DISABLE_DEPRECATION_WARNINGS
161 return NumAlwaysVisibleComponents.load(std::memory_order_relaxed) > 0;
162 PRAGMA_ENABLE_DEPRECATION_WARNINGS
163 }
164
165 void IncrementAlwaysVisibleComponents()
166 {
167 PRAGMA_DISABLE_DEPRECATION_WARNINGS
168 NumAlwaysVisibleComponents.fetch_add(1, std::memory_order_relaxed);
169 PRAGMA_ENABLE_DEPRECATION_WARNINGS
170 }
171
173 int32 DecrementAlwaysVisibleComponents()
174 {
175 PRAGMA_DISABLE_DEPRECATION_WARNINGS
176 return NumAlwaysVisibleComponents.fetch_sub(1, std::memory_order_relaxed);
177 PRAGMA_ENABLE_DEPRECATION_WARNINGS
178 }
179
180private:
181 static void Set(AActor* InActor, float LastRenderTime);
182 static FActorLastRenderTime* GetPtr(AActor* InActor);

3825 template<class T>
3826 T* FindComponentByClass() const
3827 {
3828 static_assert(TPointerIsConvertibleFromTo<T, const UActorComponent>::Value, "'T' template parameter to FindComponentByClass must be derived from UActorComponent");
3829
3830 return (T*)FindComponentByClass(T::StaticClass());
3831 }

3834 template<class T>
3835 T* FindComponentByTag(const FName& Tag) const
3836 {
3837 static_assert(TPointerIsConvertibleFromTo<T, const UActorComponent>::Value, "'T' template parameter to FindComponentByTag must be derived from UActorComponent");
3838
3839 return (T*)FindComponentByTag(T::StaticClass(), Tag);
3840 }

3843 template<class T UE_REQUIRES(TPointerIsConvertibleFromTo<T, UInterface>::Value)>
3844 UE_DEPRECATED(5.5, "This version incorrectly casts to the UInterface type used for reflection. Use FindComponentByInterface<IMyInterface>() instead")
3845 T* FindComponentByInterface() const
3846 {
3847 return (T*)FindComponentByInterface(T::StaticClass());
3848 }
3849
3851 template<class T UE_REQUIRES(TIsIInterface<T>::Value)>
3852 T* FindComponentByInterface() const
3853 {
3854 return Cast<T>(FindComponentByInterface(T::UClassType::StaticClass()));
3855 }

3864 template<class ComponentType, bool bClassIsActorComponent, bool bIncludeFromChildActors, typename Func>
3865 void ForEachComponent_Internal(TSubclassOf<UActorComponent> InComponentClass, Func InFunc) const
3866 {
3867 if (const UClass* ComponentClass = InComponentClass)
3868 {
3869 check(bClassIsActorComponent == false || ComponentClass == UActorComponent::StaticClass());
3870 check(ComponentClass->IsChildOf(ComponentType::StaticClass()));
3871
3872 // static check, so that the most common case (bIncludeFromChildActors) doesn't need to allocate an additional array :
3873 if (bIncludeFromChildActors)
3874 {
3875 TArray<AActor*, TInlineAllocator<NumInlinedActorComponents>> ChildActors;
3876 for (UActorComponent* OwnedComponent : OwnedComponents)
3877 {
3878 if (OwnedComponent)
3879 {
3880 if (bClassIsActorComponent || OwnedComponent->IsA(ComponentClass))
3881 {
3882 InFunc(static_cast<ComponentType *>(OwnedComponent));
3883 }
3884 if (UChildActorComponent* ChildActorComponent = Cast<UChildActorComponent>(OwnedComponent))
3885 {
3886 if (AActor* ChildActor = ChildActorComponent->GetChildActor())
3887 {
3888 ChildActors.Add(ChildActor);
3889 }
3890 }
3891 }
3892 }
3893
3894 for (AActor* ChildActor : ChildActors)
3895 {
3896 ChildActor->ForEachComponent_Internal<ComponentType, bClassIsActorComponent, bIncludeFromChildActors>(InComponentClass, InFunc);
3897 }
3898 }
3899 else
3900 {
3901 for (UActorComponent* OwnedComponent : OwnedComponents)
3902 {
3903 if (OwnedComponent)
3904 {
3905 if (bClassIsActorComponent || OwnedComponent->IsA(ComponentClass))
3906 {
3907 InFunc(static_cast<ComponentType *>(OwnedComponent));
3908 }
3909 }
3910 }
3911 }
3912 }
3913 }
3914
3919 template<class ComponentType, typename Func>
3920 void ForEachComponent_Internal(TSubclassOf<UActorComponent> ComponentClass, bool bIncludeFromChildActors, Func InFunc) const
3921 {
3922 static_assert(TPointerIsConvertibleFromTo<ComponentType, const UActorComponent>::Value, "'ComponentType' template parameter to ForEachComponent must be derived from UActorComponent");
3923 if (ComponentClass == UActorComponent::StaticClass())
3924 {
3925 if (bIncludeFromChildActors)
3926 {
3927 ForEachComponent_Internal<ComponentType, true /*bClassIsActorComponent*/, true /*bIncludeFromChildActors*/>(ComponentClass, InFunc);
3928 }
3929 else
3930 {
3931 ForEachComponent_Internal<ComponentType, true /*bClassIsActorComponent*/, false /*bIncludeFromChildActors*/>(ComponentClass, InFunc);
3932 }
3933 }
3934 else
3935 {
3936 if (bIncludeFromChildActors)
3937 {
3938 ForEachComponent_Internal<ComponentType, false /*bClassIsActorComponent*/, true /*bIncludeFromChildActors*/>(ComponentClass, InFunc);
3939 }
3940 else
3941 {
3942 ForEachComponent_Internal<ComponentType, false /*bClassIsActorComponent*/, false /*bIncludeFromChildActors*/>(ComponentClass, InFunc);
3943 }
3944 }
3945 }
3946
3947public:
3948
3954 template<class ComponentType, typename Func>
3955 void ForEachComponent(bool bIncludeFromChildActors, Func InFunc) const
3956 {
3957 ForEachComponent_Internal<ComponentType>(ComponentType::StaticClass(), bIncludeFromChildActors, InFunc);
3958 }
3959
3964 template<typename Func>
3965 void ForEachComponent(bool bIncludeFromChildActors, Func InFunc) const
3966 {
3967 ForEachComponent_Internal<UActorComponent>(UActorComponent::StaticClass(), bIncludeFromChildActors, InFunc);
3968 }

4876template <typename ExecuteTickLambda>
4877void FActorComponentTickFunction::ExecuteTickHelper(UActorComponent* Target, bool bTickInEditor, float DeltaTime, ELevelTick TickType, const ExecuteTickLambda& ExecuteTickFunc)
4878{
4879 if (IsValid(Target))
4880 {
4881 FScopeCycleCounterUObject ComponentScope(Target);
4882 FScopeCycleCounterUObject AdditionalScope(Target->AdditionalStatObject());
4883
4884 if (Target->bRegistered)
4885 {
4886 AActor* MyOwner = Target->GetOwner();
4887 if (TickType != LEVELTICK_ViewportsOnly || bTickInEditor ||
4888 (MyOwner && MyOwner->ShouldTickIfViewportsOnly()))
4889 {
4890 const float TimeDilation = (MyOwner ? MyOwner->CustomTimeDilation : 1.f);
4891 ExecuteTickFunc(DeltaTime * TimeDilation);
4892 }
4893 }
4894 }
4895}

4989inline ENetMode AActor::GetNetMode() const
4990{
4991 // IsRunningDedicatedServer() is a compile-time check in optimized non-editor builds.
4992 if (IsRunningDedicatedServer() && (NetDriverName == NAME_None || NetDriverName == NAME_GameNetDriver))
4993 {
4994 // Only normal net driver actors can have this optimization
4995 return NM_DedicatedServer;
4996 }
4997
4998 return InternalGetNetMode();
4999}
5000
5001inline bool AActor::IsNetMode(ENetMode Mode) const
5002{
5003#if UE_EDITOR
5004 // Editor builds are special because of PIE, which can run a dedicated server without the app running with -server.
5005 return GetNetMode() == Mode;
5006#else
5007 // IsRunningDedicatedServer() is a compile-time check in optimized non-editor builds.
5008 if (Mode == NM_DedicatedServer)
5009 {
5010 return IsRunningDedicatedServer();
5011 }
5012 else if (NetDriverName == NAME_None || NetDriverName == NAME_GameNetDriver)
5013 {
5014 // Only normal net driver actors can have this optimization
5015 return !IsRunningDedicatedServer() && (InternalGetNetMode() == Mode);
5016 }
5017 else
5018 {
5019 return (InternalGetNetMode() == Mode);
5020 }
5021#endif
5022}
